acceptance_predicates.description: Every supported handoffctl entry point and documented launcher prevents repository-local Python bytecode or redirects it outside the state repository without caller-specific environment setup.
Reconciliation validates and publishes PROJECT_STATE.md and WORKTREES.md as one matched derived projection set; interruption cannot expose a mixed or falsely current pair.
Concurrent reconciliation has one serialized winner; timeout or contention returns a typed recoverable diagnostic and preserves the last valid projection set.
A stale projection is repaired through a documented idempotent handoffctl path, never by direct generated-view editing, and unrelated active task records remain unchanged.
A configured primary state checkout completes reconcile, snapshot, and doctor --live with no state-file size violation or repository-local bytecode.
The repair does not weaken locks, size/privacy guards, signing/DCO policy, or protected-main rules, and does not mutate product channel behavior owned by AR-1674.

definition_of_done: Focused unit, fault, and concurrency tests cover bytecode handling, interrupted render, projection freshness, lock contention, recovery, and unchanged unrelated task state.
Independent exact-head review and required coordinator CI pass for a signed DCO integration.
A post-merge configured-primary reconciliation, snapshot, and live doctor receipt is recorded without repository-local bytecode.

inputs.description: Configured primary ASB coordinator-state checkout containing derived projection files and coordinator lock configuration.
A valid concurrent coordinator holder used to exercise serialization and typed contention diagnostics.

outputs.description: Validated atomic derived projection publication and idempotent stale-view recovery.
Central coordinator execution policy that keeps Python bytecode out of the state repository.
Privacy-safe post-merge reconcile, snapshot, and live doctor evidence.

gates.description: No mixed, stale, oversized, or manual generated projection can pass doctor.
Concurrent mutation/reconciliation has a defined winner and typed loser with recovery evidence.
No repository-local bytecode, private runtime configuration, or credentials are introduced by supported coordinator paths.
